detail.longDescription: New post: "headless Slack" is Guillermo Rauch's name for Vercel Board, a message board where coding agents claim tasks on a lease, post updates and hand back PRs, synced with Slack and GitHub. The design is sound. The catch is in Vercel's own docs: agents read messages as instructions, so lock down who can post. https:// blog.manig.dev/blog/headless-s lack-vercel-board # AIAgents # Vercel
